title: Coordinates of the lattice face map b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)}
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let ι : Fin k → Fin P be injective, let b : Fin P → ℤ and let y ∈ Euclid k. Put e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1 ∈ Euclid P and Φ(y) := toLp(b) + Σ_{j : Fin k} y_j • e_{ι(j)} ∈ Euclid P, where toLp(b) is the vector with coordinates (b_i : ℝ). Then (i) Φ(y)_{ι(m)} = b_{ι(m)} + y_m for every m : Fin k, and (ii) Φ(y)_l = b_l for every l : Fin P with ι(m) ≠ l for all m : Fin k.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (ι : Fin k → Fin P) (b : Fin P → ℤ) (y : Euclid k), Function.Injective ι → (∀ m, (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) (ι m) = (b (ι m) : ℝ) + y m) ∧ (∀ l, (∀ m, ι m ≠ l) → (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)) l = (b l : ℝ))
